assessments.reasoning: For economic_maintenance: Section H Question 1 (SIDIV1) captures activity/pension status, and Section G Question 2 (OFEMP2) records receipt of unemployment benefits (yes/no), but the instrument does not measure income or support by member across all sources (wages, informal work, pensions, remittances). For labor_burden: Section C Question 34 (HORASH) records hours in paid work, but the questionnaire does not capture hours spent in unpaid domestic or care work. For property_asset_control: Section HG1 establishes household budgeting/composition, but no questions record dwelling tenure, land, or asset ownership by member. For decision_making: Section C Question 30 (DECHOR1) asks about control over work schedules, but no questions address decision-making by household sphere (such as child-rearing, daily consumption, or major financial choices).
